candidate_sentence_map.S1: Infortar Group reported a significant increase in revenue for the financial year 2025, reaching EUR 1,837 million, compared to EUR 1,372 million in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: This growth was primarily driven by the full-year consolidation of Tallink Grupp, which Infortar gained controlling influence over in August 2024, and improved performance in the energy segment.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: EBITDA also rose substantially to EUR 228 million from EUR 145 million in the previous year, reflecting the inclusion of Tallink’s full-year results and an approximate EUR 12 million improvement in Elenger’s EBITDA.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: The EBITDA margin expanded to 12.4% from 10.6% in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Operating profit increased to EUR 109 million from EUR 77 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: However, net profit attributable to the owners of the parent decreased sharply to EUR 70.6 million from EUR 191.3 million in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: The report explicitly attributes this decline in net profit to one-off effects related to the initial consolidation of Tallink Group in 2024, which included a gain from bargain purchase and remeasurement of previously held interests that did not recur in 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Total assets amounted to EUR 2,597 million, a decrease from EUR 2,715 million in 2024, while total equity increased to EUR 1,175 million from EUR 1,166 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: The equity ratio improved to 45% from 43%.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Interest-bearing liabilities decreased to EUR 1,071 million from EUR 1,223 million, and net debt fell to EUR 852 million from EUR 1,056 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: The net debt to EBITDA ratio improved to 3.7 from 4.0.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: The group maintained a current ratio of 0.8.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: The decrease in loan liabilities reflects loan repayments across several group entities, including at the Tallink level.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: In the maritime transport segment, Tallink carried 5.53 million passengers, a 0.9% decrease year-on-year, while cargo units transported fell by 19.2%.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Revenue from vessel chartering helped balance seasonal fluctuations.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: In the energy segment, Elenger delivered 18 TWh of LNG cargoes, maintaining a market share of approximately one quarter in the Finland-Baltic region.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Elenger expanded its renewable portfolio by commissioning a new solar power plant in Latvia and completing its first large-scale battery storage facility.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: In the real estate segment, a logistics center in Laagri was completed, and construction began on a commercial space for Depo.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: Supporting sector developments included the acquisition of Estonia Farmid and Oisu Biogaas, strengthening the group's agriculture and biomethane production capabilities.
candidate_sentence_map.S20: The group paid dividends of EUR 3 per share, totaling EUR 62 million.
